request.brief: The Imperial Council decision category for Austria-Hungary circa 1910–1918. Its programmes address provincial grievances and fund reforms across the empire. One period brass Habsburg double-headed eagle as an official seal over a closed folded petition in ivory; crown and double eagle are part of the same silhouette. Frame using the subdued native decision-category disc and no text. High contrast and pared-down heraldry readable at the native decision-category size. Match the reference's UI framing and rendering, not its symbol. No map, no flags, no legible words, no modern Austrian republican arms.

prompt.text:
Create one Hearts of Iron IV decision category icon: The Imperial Council decision category for Austria-Hungary circa 1910–1918. Its programmes address provincial grievances and fund reforms across the empire. One period brass Habsburg double-headed eagle as an official seal over a closed folded petition in ivory; crown and double eagle are part of the same silhouette. Frame using the subdued native decision-category disc and no text. High contrast and pared-down heraldry readable at the native decision-category size. Match the reference's UI framing and rendering, not its symbol. No map, no flags, no legible words, no modern Austrian republican arms.

Requirements:
- Take the frame, outline and overall form from the style anchor images, not from a fixed family form; the size, transparency, margin and readability requirements here still apply.
- The symbol is large: it fills most of the disc and may overlap the rim, never a small mark inside a wide empty disc.
- Painted, slightly aged, readable at 52x40 pixels.
- Real transparent background outside the disc.
- Small canvas: at 52x40 pixels only one bold object reads. Draw it with a few large, solid shapes and thick parts, nothing smaller than a tenth of the canvas: no thin parallel lines (rails, wires, ropes, cables, railings), no lattices or open frameworks, no groups of small figures, no scene, ground or water line.
- Leave a small empty margin around the disc.

Reference images, in the order attached:
1. style anchor: match its painting style, palette and level of detail
The style anchor images were chosen for this image. Match their form, framing, materials and palette; the vanilla form described under Requirements applies only where they do not show one.

Avoid: text; letters or numbers; watermark or signature; a drawn checkerboard pattern; a square backdrop behind the subject; thin parallel lines, wires or lattices; several small objects or figures.

Produce exactly one image.
negative: a square backdrop behind the subject
thin parallel lines, wires or lattices

style_sources.method: descriptors (Lab mean/std, saturation, Sobel edge density, alpha coverage, dark-outline share, 6-bin hue histogram) are standardised; deterministic k-medoids (PAM, no random start, candidates ordered by content hash) picks up to 24 images for statistics and drift. Up to 4 images are sent: a pinned style as ordered; otherwise nation-specific files are left out unless the brief names the country, about half the slots are drawn from the files whose names best match the brief's words and themes and the rest from the family's most style-typical generic files, all seeded by a hash of the family, asset and brief
